walkthroughs.body_html:
Area B: Personal and Social Life — a core area of GCSE German.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Area B: Personal and Social Life brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Area B: Personal and Social Life.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which sentence has correct word order with 'weil'?
options: Ich mag Englisch, weil es nützlich ist.
Ich mag Englisch, weil es ist nützlich.
Ich mag Englisch, weil ist es nützlich.
Ich mag Englisch, weil nützlich es ist.
the canteen
the timetable
the homework
the school yard

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I use my phone every day' in German?
options: Ich benutze mein Handy jeden Tag.
Before the verb.
Ich gebrauche mein Phone jeden Tag.
Ich nutze mein Telefon jeden Tag.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between 'ich will' and 'ich möchte'?
options: Ich will = I want (strong, direct); ich möchte = I would like (polite).
Ich will is future tense.
Before the verb.
They mean the same thing.

mcqs.q: Where does 'nicht' go in 'I don't like the film' (Der Film gefällt mir nicht)?
options: Before the verb.
At the end (negating the whole sentence).
Ich will is future tense.
Right after the subject.
